scope.population: 10455129 taker fills over 9 coin-window cells; the cross-month cells hold out BY WALLET, a wallet clearing [50, 100] fills in BOTH months of a pair

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

input_builder.basis: no stamp; `period` sits at key index 3 where the legacy builder puts it last, and the file holds 8 windows where the legacy builder can produce at most three

scope.object: cross-month (out-of-month) persistence of per-wallet 10s adverse-selection toxicity
scope.dedup: one obs per (hash, taker), size-weighted VWAP entry
scope.holdout: BY WALLET - a wallet must clear K fills in BOTH months of a pair
scope.seed_rule: per-cell: seed = first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of '<master_seed>|<coin>|<period_a>|<period_b>|<K>|<statistic tag>', tags corr / corr_no_whales / rel_a / rel_b, coin='POOLED' for the pooled cells. The seed is a pure function of the cell's identity, not of its position in the loop, so a cell computed on its own reproduces the p-value it has inside the full grid and adding a coin, a window or a K leaves existing cells unchanged.
scope.method: split-half (Spearman-Brown) reliability + disattenuated cross-month Spearman; permutation null; BH-FDR; whale-drop

cross_month_fdr.family: cross-month persistence Spearman p-values (per-coin + pooled cells, ordered period pairs x K)
cross_month_fdr.count_note: family_size counts ordered pairs and therefore counts every comparison twice; quote n_distinct_comparisons in prose. The BH rejection set is identical either way.
cross_month_fdr.method: sort ascending, q_(i) = p_(i) * m / i, running minimum from the largest p downward, clipped to 1; NaN p-values are carried through and excluded from the family size
cross_month_fdr.threshold_meaning: the p-value cutoff actually applied: the largest rank k with p_(k) <= k*alpha/m, times alpha/m. With no rejection it is the rank-one bar the best cell failed

outliers_note: Pairs listed here are LOW-POWER / LOW-RELIABILITY outliers (thin common-wallet count or near-zero split-half reliability). Their disattenuated Spearman is unstable - read the observed rho and n, NOT the disattenuated value, and do not let them carry the cross-month claim. The decisive read is the pooled cells with BH-FDR survival.
